about:
Ferrin IronWorks is based in Nashville, Tennessee, and was founded in 2005 by Andrew Ferrin, who serves as owner and operator. The business began with a focus on handcrafted metal art and fabrication, drawing on Ferrin's passion for creating custom metal pieces.

The company specializes in handcrafted metal art and custom fabrication, employing a team of craftsmen to produce one-of-a-kind metalwork. While specific facility size and production volumes are not disclosed, the operation centers on bespoke projects rather than high-volume runs.

Ferrin IronWorks serves clients seeking custom metal art, architectural metalwork, and fabricated metal components. The company does not publicly list specific industry sectors or named customers, but its work typically appeals to residential, commercial, and artistic markets.

The firm emphasizes its craft-driven approach, with Andrew Ferrin highlighting a passion for beautiful custom metal pieces as the foundation of the business. This artisan-focused philosophy distinguishes the shop in a market often dominated by automated production.
